subject.title: feat: agent_settled extension event for true session idle

question: Should `agent_settled` become a supported plugin-SDK lifecycle event with the proposed no-continuation and handoff semantics?
rationale: This is a new externally consumable event rather than a repair to an established contract; code review can assess implementation, but only maintainers can choose the permanent API guarantee.

options.title: Sponsor the lifecycle event
options.body: Accept the proposed event as a public contract, with its settlement-after-continuations and no-handoff semantics covered by the focused session tests.

options.title: Keep settlement internal for now
options.body: Defer the public SDK event until maintainers define a broader lifecycle-event model or identify additional consumer requirements.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the lifecycle event
recommendation.body: Accept the proposed event as a public contract, with its settlement-after-continuations and no-handoff semantics covered by the focused session tests.

likelyOwner.reason: The current proposal is the available routing point for the new lifecycle API, though broader current-main history could not be inspected here.
